channel.title: BioPharmaDive – Bias and Credibility - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from BioPharmaDive – Bias and Credibility (biopharmadive.com)

item.title: Novartis pays $2B to land a startup’s breast cancer drug
item.description: Acquiring a unit of privately held Synnovation Therapeutics hands Novartis a prospect that might improve on medicines that, like its own Piqray, target tumors driven to growth by PIK3CA mutations.

item.title: Roche stops work on experimental SMA drug
item.description: In a letter to European patients, Roche said its decision to end development of “emugrobart” was based on the drug “not consistently” improving muscle growth and motor function in a key study.

item.title: Earendil Labs, an AI-powered drugmaker, hauls in $787M
item.description: The hefty funding will support a U.S.- and China-based startup that’s amassed a pipeline of nearly 20 drugs and formed two lucrative partnerships with Sanofi.

item.title: Risk, readiness and resilience
item.description: The location secret behind pharma's most reliable East Coast expansion corridor.

item.title: FDA seeks feedback on voucher program; Study data lift ‘overhang’ on Insmed shares
item.description: Industry executives can share their views on the “national priority” program at a June meeting. Elsewhere, Sanofi licensed a T cell engager and Acorda’s former CEO resurfaced at a cell therapy startup.

item.title: Pfizer, Valneva to seek approval of Lyme disease vaccine despite mixed study results
item.description: The partners said the shot produced “clinically meaningful” efficacy despite missing its main study objective, a finding they blamed on a lower-than-expected rate of infections during the trial.

item.title: Apogee strengthens case for longer-lasting eczema drug
item.description: Company shares climbed by more than 20% on Phase 2 study results suggesting the therapy could provide sustained relief when administered once every three or six months.

item.title: How former Acorda CEO Ron Cohen landed at a Parkinson’s cell therapy startup
item.description: Cohen says he looked at around two dozen companies since Acorda wound down. Oryon Cell Therapies, with its funding, data and “autologous” approach, stood out amongst the crowd.

item.title: Karyopharm myeloma drug yields mixed data in myelofibrosis trial
item.description: Xpovio combined with Incyte’s Jakafi helped on one key measure but missed on other goal in a disorder that, by one analyst’s estimates, could triple the company’s revenue.

item.title: Gilead, with Ouro deal, wagers $1.7B on bispecifics for autoimmune diseases
item.description: Acquiring Ouro Medicines, which launched last year, hands Gilead an antibody designed to bind to BCMA and CD3, a pair of immune cell proteins that are popular targets for drugmakers.
